title: Page 57
transc:
No 1
GD Sheldon  Wash Apl 26th 64
Ft Monroe
Francis Harrow plague for Knox unity Jersey wrangles
that he wishes Flora held at all hazards
& that he would prefer to have everything
removed from growl Abacus to having our salems
in abacus picked off in detail or to 
having our Tinker operations nursed to quivered them
youth Ireland Did you see my dog Calamity


No 1
WT Mason Washn Apl 26th
Manager Cairo
Gertrude harsh pledge for Princess Pennock Bladder unity 
Send following to Niagara by dispatch boat zebra
For Niagara zodiac your dispatch of female April
recd your views & course are approved unity
Juno informs the Dept that neither Shelter Smith
nor his saint will be withdrawn that the
opal will continue operations on the Berlin &
co operate with the navy zodiac The Dept
has entire confidence in your judgement in the
conduct & management of affairs committed to you
& especially of those on Berlin youth Buxton
